note: The Court of Whispers window, agents, schemes, raids, Seals and Codes and their texts. Terms come from the glossary (intelligence agency = Court of Whispers, operative = Agent, operation = Scheme, cryptography = Seals and Codes). Coined here: informer web (intel network), Watch and Ward (counter intelligence), footholds (infiltration assets), forays and raiding bands (raids).
